content: Ni kapahieun sounpar me Darius wiewiahki nanmwarki lapalap, ni rahn kaeisek pahieun keduwaun sounpwong (sounpwong en Kislep), KAUN-O ketikihong ie mahsen ehu.
Mehn Pedel kadaralahr Sareser oh Rekemelek oh neirail ohl akan ong ni Tehnpas Sarawien KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalap, pwe re en peki sapwellimen KAUN-O kupwuramwahu

oh pwe re en kalelapak rehn samworo ko oh soukohp ko peidek wet: “Ia duwe, se en usehlahte mwahmwahieiki ohlahn Tehnpas Sarawio, ni at pahn kin kaisihsol ni kelimaun sounpwong duwen me se kin wiewia erein sounpar tohtohie?”
Eri, iet mahsen en KAUN-O me kohieng ie.
E mahsanih, “Padahkihong tohn sahpwet oh samworo kan me ni ahnsou me re kaisihsol oh mwahiei ni kelimaun oh keduwaun sounpwong erein sounpar isihseket, re sohte wia pwe re en kawauwih ie.
Oh ni ar kin tungoale oh nim mehkot, re kin wia ong ni pein kansenamwahuparail.”

Ih met me KAUN-O mahsanihong soukohp en mwowe ko ni ahnsou me Serusalem mihmi nan eh pai oh diren aramas oh ni ahnsowo kaidehnte nan kahnimw kan me diren aramas, ahpw pil aramas tohto kousoan ni sapwen palieir oh palikapi en tepin dohl kan.
“Mahsie I ketikihong nei aramas akan kosonned pwukat: ‘Kumwail pahn tehk mwahu pwe en mie pwuhng pahrek, oh kumwail pahn kasalehda amwail kadek oh mahk nanpwungamwail.
Kumwail dehr kahpwalih liohdi kan, me sepwoupwou kan, mehn liki kan me koukousoan rehmwail, de mehmen me anahne sawas. Oh dehr wiahda koasoandi me pahn kauwehla emenemen kumwail.
“Ahpw nei aramas akan keptakaila sohte men rong. Re ritingedi ar lamalam
oh kakeptakaila ar mohngiong kan. I engiengdahr kowahlap pwehki ar sohte men rong padahk kan me I ketikihong soukohp en mahs ako.
I sohte sapeng ar kin kapakap pwehki ar sohte men rong ei mahsen.
I koakoahirailla rasehng kisinieng pwe re en kousoanla nan sapwen mehn liki kan. Sahpw kaselel wet ahpw wiahla sapwtehn, sohte emen me kousoan ie.”
